tools.name: resolve_location
tools.description: Resolve a town name to coordinates before geographic searches. Multiple matches require disambiguation. Results include source attribution and public DalVivo URLs.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Find events by date, coordinates, keywords, free admission and family suitability. Geographic filters require both coordinates. Maximum 10 results per page. Results include source attribution and public DalVivo URLs.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get a published event by its id from search_events. Includes status, source and freshness when available. Results include source attribution and public DalVivo URLs.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Find places around coordinates. Groups: outdoors, heritage, family, all. Opening hours and accessibility are unverified source data. Results include source attribution and public DalVivo URLs.

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Get a place by its id from search_places, including OpenStreetMap and description attribution. Results include source attribution and public DalVivo URLs.

tools.name: search_day_plans
tools.description: Find available day plans around coordinates for a date and audience. Returns ids for get_day_plan. Does not create a new itinerary. Results include source attribution and public DalVivo URLs.

tools.name: get_day_plan
tools.description: Get a public itinerary by its id from search_day_plans. Check live and validity dates; hidden itineraries are unavailable. Results include source attribution and public DalVivo URLs.
